patches.audit_note: Official About page read; no current year-qualified citation or acceptance metric located there. A 2020 anniversary editorial makes an older RePEc positioning claim without a reproducible metric period/denominator; it was not converted into a current JIF or difficulty rank. Independent review reopened the official About page: explicit zero submission/publication fees and editorial screening followed by external review are supported. The 12-week goal is not selectivity evidence. Source: https://openjournals.uwaterloo.ca/index.php/rofea/about .

Official About and submission policies inspected. No year-qualified journal-level citation metric or acceptance statistic located in these policies. Review-time objectives are not measured selectivity, and the existing AI-text restriction remains applicable. Independent review reopened About and author instructions. Original articles and critical surveys are accepted; book reviews, interviews and thesis summaries are distinct non-peer-reviewed content. Explicit zero submission/publication charges and the prohibition on substantially AI-written text are confirmed. Sources: https://ejpe.org/journal/about ; https://ejpe.org/journal/about/submissions .

Official metric and statistics announcements and About page independently read; current announcement also confirms closure. Use the newer, explicitly dated 2025 citation announcement instead of the About page’s 2024 citation figures. Preserve submission_status=closed and its evidence; this ranking patch does not make the venue an active recommendation. Independent review confirmed zero charges, closed submissions and the 2026-10-19 effective date from current official submissions/announcements. All three retained metrics were independently checked. The cumulative counts leave three received manuscripts unreconciled; preserve that caveat and do not advertise the venue as open. Sources: https://reunido.uniovi.es/index.php/EBL/about/submissions ; https://reunido.uniovi.es/index.php/EBL/announcement ; https://reunido.uniovi.es/index.php/EBL/announcement/view/150 ; https://reunido.uniovi.es/index.php/EBL/announcement/view/189 .

Official aims, review policy and acceptance/rejection table read. Regional location and missing JIF were not used to assign difficulty. No year-qualified official citation metric was located in the reviewed journal material. Independent review confirmed the blanket no-author/institution-fees policy, double-blind external review and the exact 2025 table (36 accepted, 35 rejected, rounded 51%). Author instructions explicitly mention review as an article category, so review is added to formats. The denominator is tabulated accept/reject outcomes, not all received manuscripts. Sources: https://dergipark.org.tr/en/pub/ekoist/price-policy ; https://dergipark.org.tr/en/pub/ekoist/page/8959 ; https://dergipark.org.tr/en/pub/ekoist/rejection-statistics ; https://dergipark.org.tr/en/pub/ekoist/writing-rules .

Official homepage and both one-page policy PDFs read. No official year-qualified citation or acceptance metric located in this bounded search. Editorial-board affiliations, claimed prestige and journal sponsorship were not substituted for selectivity data. Independent review read the ethics, author-guide and peer-review PDFs. Fees and research-only scope are supported; review normally uses two referees but the policy permits exceptional single-report/editor handling. High difficulty is changed to unknown: originality, significance and a discretionary priority screen alone do not calibrate comparative selectivity. Sources: https://www.mechanism-design.org/dox/ethics.pdf ; https://www.mechanism-design.org/dox/GuideForAuthors.pdf ; https://www.mechanism-design.org/dox/PeerReviewPolicies.pdf .

difficulty.basis: Reviewer judgment: no comparative difficulty band is established. Official policy requires originality, validity and significance and permits desk rejection for insufficient priority, but supplies neither acceptance statistics nor a specific contribution threshold that calibrates high difficulty relative to other economics journals. Replicable data and substantive mechanism/institution design remain fit requirements; unknown does not imply easy acceptance.

patches.audit_note: Official homepage and aims read. The homepage’s 16-day median first decision has no displayed measurement year/population, so no year-qualified turnaround metric was created. Its 2025 downloads measure readership, not acceptance. Independent review confirmed the journal-specific no-submission-charge policy, no-APC subscription alternative and avoidable print-colour charges. The 2025 JIF 1.9 and five-year JIF 1.7 were independently corroborated on the official homepage. Neither the undated 16-day decision median nor citation impact determines difficulty. Sources: https://link.springer.com/journal/41294/submission-guidelines ; https://link.springer.com/journal/41294/how-to-publish-with-us ; https://link.springer.com/journal/41294 .

Official OUP About/Why Publish pages read. OUP homepage initially timed out, legacy ScienceDirect insights returned 403, and an independent portal fetch was inaccessible. No legacy citation/acceptance value was imported or treated as a prospective OUP metric. Preserve needs_verification, the unresolved live route and the prohibition on using the staged portal for live submissions; no active recommendation is created. Independent review read OUP Why Publish: the explicit fee promise is for its announced 2027 chapter. Reviewer requests to the linked yjcec portal returned inaccessible/403 and author instructions timed out; the earlier fee auditor's directly observed staging warning is preserved, not claimed independently re-observed. Current free submission remains unverified. Scope wording is corrected so a marketing invitation cannot imply an operational live portal. Source: https://academic.oup.com/jce/pages/why-publish .
patches.scope_notes: Political economy, including institutions, culture, political behaviour, development and economic history. The renamed OUP journal and its zero-cost standard licence describe an announced 2027 transition. Its marketing invitation to submit does not establish a usable live November 2026 route: the fee auditor observed that the linked portal is still under development and prohibits live manuscripts. Current submission availability and applicable legacy fees remain unresolved; needs_verification is retained.

patches.audit_note: Official homepage and scope read. The 9-day median first-decision figure has no displayed period or defined manuscript population, and 2025 downloads are usage rather than citation/selectivity. No missing JIF was interpreted as evidence of easier acceptance. Independent review confirmed both necessary fee elements: the owning society explicitly makes manuscript submission free worldwide; the publisher says the society covers publication APCs. Single-anonymous peer review, original/literature-review formats, pure-statistics exclusion and optional language services are supported. Sources: https://www.sses.swiss/journal/ ; https://link.springer.com/journal/41937/submission-guidelines .

Official About and For Authors pages read directly; initial incorrect/inaccessible homepage paths were replaced with the actual About PSE link. Fee audit’s unresolved publication costs remain unchanged. Independent review read current About, author and ethics pages. No submission fee is explicit; a current blanket publication/page-cost exemption remains unverified. The 15% figure is explicitly 2025 with no denominator. Current scope advertises original theoretical/empirical/policy papers, not a distinct review article route; formats is conservatively narrowed. The ethics page requires a dedicated AI declaration for all manuscripts, more broadly than the author checklist's if-used wording. Sources: https://www.pse-journal.hr/en/about-pse/ ; https://www.pse-journal.hr/en/for-authors/ ; https://www.pse-journal.hr/en/ethical-guidelines/ .
patches.scope_notes: Original theoretical, empirical and policy-oriented papers analysing public-sector roles at macro, sector and micro levels. Health financing and existing-data policy studies can fit; biomedical studies such as clinical trials are excluded. A separate general review-article route was not established from current official instructions. The ethics page requires a dedicated AI declaration for all manuscripts; the author checklist specifically describes disclosure when AI was used.

route.conditions: Official author instructions and submission-site About page explicitly exclude submission fees. A current blanket exemption for publication/page or other compulsory charges remains unverified; older DOAJ information does not settle current costs. Manuscripts are limited to 9,000 words and independent researchers are eligible. The ethics page requires a dedicated AI declaration for all manuscripts, while the author checklist describes disclosure if AI was used; preserve the broader current ethics requirement.
route.other_mandatory_costs: Unknown: current publication/page-cost exemption not established; no paid membership or conference requirement is stated in the reviewed author instructions.

fee_evidence.note: Official current instructions explicitly exclude submission fees, limit manuscripts to 9,000 words, permit independent-researcher identification, and specify AI disclosure.
Official journal submission-site About page separately confirms no submission fee, without a blanket current publication/page-cost exclusion.
Current ethics page confirms no submission fee and external review; it requires a dedicated AI declaration for all manuscripts but does not supply a blanket publication-cost exclusion.

patches.audit_note: Official year-labelled metrics, author criteria and publisher metric definitions read. Fee status remains needs_verification; a high-difficulty band does not certify a free submission/publication route. Independent review read author instructions, confirming original/review formats, routine-application exclusions, double-blind external review and the AI disclosure/editor-discretion rule. Publisher metric definitions were checked, but journal-specific metrics returned inaccessible/403 and the homepage timed out: all three figures remain attributed to the ranking role, not independently corroborated in this review. Unresolved standard costs remain needs_verification. Sources: https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/page/journal/10991050/homepage/forauthors.html ; https://authors.wiley.com/author-resources/Journal-Authors/find-a-journal/journal-metrics.html .

route.conditions: Journal offers standard subscription licensing or optional paid immediate OA. Online colour is free; authors may decline paid print colour and use black-and-white print figures. The current instructions do not explicitly establish zero submission fees or every standard publication/page cost, so the route remains unverified. Free Format refers to formatting flexibility. OA institutional accounts or agreements are conditional and cannot establish an unconditional free route. Generative-AI use to develop manuscript content requires detailed disclosure in Methods or Acknowledgements; human authors retain responsibility and the editor decides permissibility. Spelling/grammar/general-editing tools are exempt from that disclosure rule.
route.other_mandatory_costs: Unknown compulsory submission/publication/page costs. Paid print colour and author services can be declined; no compulsory society membership or conference registration is stated.

fee_evidence.note: Journal offers standard licensing and optional paid OA, free online colour, and optional paid print colour; no explicit blanket zero submission/standard-publication-cost statement was located.
APC applies if authors select OA; subscription licensing remains available if institutional OA funding is denied. Institutional coverage is conditional, not an unconditional free-OA policy.

patches.audit_note: Current owner About/guidelines and official hosting-platform metrics inspected. Owner calls its current impact factor 0.8; platform says 0.4 and CiteScore 2.3. None is assigned an explicit metric year, and the impact-factor values conflict. Excluded these from the year-qualified metrics array instead of guessing a year or silently choosing one. Independent review reopened current Mendel University About and author instructions: zero submission/APCs, submissions throughout the year and double-blind review are explicit. Its 0.8 current impact-factor claim has no metric year; the earlier ranking role's undated conflicting platform values remain unadjudicated and excluded. No difficulty inference follows from regional focus. Sources: https://roep.mendelu.cz/artkey/inf-990000-0300_about-the-journal.php ; https://roep.mendelu.cz/artkey/inf-990000-0500_submission-guidelines.php .

Official About page and editorial statistics inspected. The About page explicitly labels CiteScore as 2025; its percentile lacks a displayed category denominator and was omitted. Editorial-statistics tables exposed headings but no numerical rows in the fetched page; no acceptance rate was invented. Independent review confirmed explicit zero submission/APCs, original economic-policy scope, external double-blind review, no absolute length limit and the target of 7,000 words. The official About page independently corroborates CiteScore 1.2 (2025). No acceptance statistic or easy label was inferred. Sources: https://revistas.udc.es/index.php/ejge/information/authors ; https://revistas.udc.es/index.php/ejge/about ; https://revistas.udc.es/index.php/ejge/about/submissions .

Official scope, four-page instructions and metrics tab read. Platform lists CiteScore 1.4, SJR 0.209, SNIP 0.439 and h5 measures without a stated metric year/window; all were omitted from the year-qualified metrics array. No acceptance figure located in the inspected policies. Independent review read all four author-instruction pages and official scope: no submission/processing fees, double-blind review, original and systematic/critical-review formats, 40-page limit and manuscript AI declarations for articles published from November 2026 are supported. The displayed citation values lack metric years and remain excluded. Sources: https://reference-global.com/download/document/journal/CEEJ/Submission_and_Formatting_Instructions.pdf ; https://reference-global.com/journal/CEEJ .

Direct About/author/evaluation-page retrieval remained restricted, and ordinary HTTP retrieval returned a challenge page. Official search-indexed policy text was available but is weaker than direct page evidence; no unverified metric was imported. A 2024 accepted-to-publication timing claim in an official call is neither review duration nor acceptance probability and was not used for ranking. Independent review directly retrieved the evaluation policy, confirming at least two external double-blind reviewers. About, OA, author and AI direct fetches were restricted; official indexed policy text corroborates blanket no-author fees and the AI-image prohibition/disclosure requirement. Earlier fee-role direct observations are retained; this review does not claim independent direct access to those fee/AI pages. Sources: https://revistas.pucp.edu.pe/index.php/economia/normas_evaluacion ; https://revistas.pucp.edu.pe/index.php/economia/about ; https://revistas.pucp.edu.pe/index.php/economia/oa ; https://revistas.pucp.edu.pe/index.php/economia/ai .

findings.resolution: Independently confirmed submissions are closed from 2026-10-19 until further notice; preserve submission_status=closed and exclude it from currently open recommendations.

findings.resolution: Replaced scope_notes; preserve needs_verification and all fee-auditor staging evidence. Reviewer read the prospective OUP fee page but could not independently retrieve the staged portal.

findings.resolution: Replaced the full difficulty object with unknown while retaining actual contribution, replication and peer-review requirements.

findings.resolution: Replaced formats with original_research and stated the bounded evidence limit; this does not claim all synthesis is forbidden.

findings.resolution: Replaced formats with original_research, methods and review; fee status and double-blind review remain supported.

findings.resolution: Complete route and scope replacements preserve both formulations and the broader ethics requirement.

findings.resolution: Recorded the access distinction, corroborated official indexed no-author-fee/AI restrictions, directly read the external-review policy, and preserved previous direct-source evidence without claiming identical reviewer coverage.

findings.issue: Undated current impact-factor wording and earlier noted platform conflict cannot support a year-qualified metric or difficulty ranking.
findings.resolution: Confirmed the owner's undated 0.8 wording and preserved the empty metric array and unknown difficulty.

notes: Fifth distinct economics role. Read project AGENTS.md, research/CONTRACT.md and all four role files; reviewed merged implications for all 14 candidates (10 discovery, four diamond). Only research/review/economics.json is written. This is independent documentary agent review, not human scientific, usability or manuscript approval.

At least one official source was independently read for every candidate: RoEA About; EJPE About/submissions; EBL submissions/About/announcements/statistics/metrics; EKOIST fee/review/author/statistics/ethics; jMID ethics/author/review PDFs; CES author/publishing/homepage; OUP JCE prospective fee page; Swiss society and publisher instructions; PSE About/author/ethics; Health Economics author guide; RoEP current owner About/author pages; EJGE author/About/submissions; CEEJ scope and four-page instructions; PUCP direct evaluation policy plus official indexed fee/AI/author policies.

All 11 verified_free fee certifications were challenged. Retained the fee audit classifications: 11 verified_free fee policies and three needs_verification routes (JCE, PSE, Health Economics). EBL is included only in the fee-policy count and remains closed; 10 records therefore combine verified_free, peer-reviewed and not explicitly closed. No paid OA, agreement, selective waiver, required membership or conference registration was relabelled unconditionally free.

JCE portal and Health Economics metric page were inaccessible in both browser-tool and ordinary HTTP attempts (HTTP 403); OUP author instructions and some homepages timed out. These prior role observations are not independently reverified here. Official Editorial Manager documentation explains staging warnings generally, but does not itself prove the yjcec site state; the fee auditor's direct observation remains its source.

Eight of 11 retained metric objects were independently corroborated: EBL JIF/CiteScore/cumulative acceptance, EKOIST acceptance, CES two JIF figures, PSE acceptance and EJGE CiteScore. All three Health Economics values remain prior ranking-role evidence. Metric definitions were independently checked against Wiley. No metric object was added, deleted or assigned a guessed year.

EBL's counts leave three manuscripts unreconciled and include pending cases; PSE has no denominator; EKOIST's outcome sum is not the full received cohort; Wiley uses final decisions and includes desk rejection. These statistics do not form a common acceptance-probability scale. Citation metrics alone never determine a difficulty band.

One comparative difficulty band changed: jMID high to unknown. Retained historical EBL high, Health Economics high and EKOIST moderate as explicitly bounded agent judgments, not manuscript odds; eleven of the fourteen economics bands are now unknown. No absent-metric or regional venue was labelled easy.

Format corrections add EKOIST review and remove the unsupported general PSE review route. EJPE's substantially AI-written-text restriction, PUCP's AI-image ban, CEEJ's November declarations and PSE/Health Economics disclosure rules remain material operational conditions. A fee label does not certify AI-policy compatibility.

Peer-review types remain peer_reviewed for ordinary research routes. EJPE auxiliary contributions have distinct non-peer review status; jMID policy allows exceptional single-report handling. No claim is made that every content type in each journal receives external review.

No accounts created, venue contact, manuscript submission, external messages, remote writes, merge, deployment or publication occurred. JSON/ID/merged-field checks assess the deliverable structure only.
